title: An Icy Road
subtitle: Beneath the ice the answers lie—for them, for her, for you.

items.text: An Icy Road

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: The true horror happened on the third day, when we reached the hinterland. An aurora australis appeared in the sky in the broad daylight.

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: Solar flares and the coronal mass ejections that came with them caused the aurora to appear so bright that it was almost blinding.

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: Friele saw it as a warning. She said that exploring the hinterland was a profanation of the Creator.

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: Koht, however, stood against her. He said that the snow brick windbreak we made would protect us and we couldn't let all those days of hard work be in vain.

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: No one knew that the real terror was beneath the snow, deep below our feet.

items.speaker: Team Member I
items.text: The sextant was right. As long as we stick to this direction ...

items.speaker: Team Member I
items.text: AAAAAGGGHHHH!!!!

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: Day 5. Eide has been left behind.

items.speaker: Team Member II
items.text: This is an emergency situation. We need some people to shift focus to rebuilding the windbreak.

items.speaker: Team Member II
items.text: Those of you who're fixing the communication devices and getting rid of the EMI—drop it for now!

items.speaker: Team Member II
items.text: Devil! D-Demon! Hahahahahaha! AAAHHHHHHH!
Day 7. Koht is gone. The situation is getting worse.

items.speaker: Team Member III
items.text: Finally, this damned place has shown its claws. I told you we shouldn't have headed so far into the hinterland! We're in way over our heads.

items.speaker: Team Member III
items.text: Farewell, everyone. There's no escaping it now. The voice in my head has become one with me, so, so let it end with me. Hahaha. Once I'm gone, it will be gone forever too.

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: Day 15.

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: Day 23.

items.speaker: Nautika's Diary
items.text: Day 30. Everyone is gone. Only Friele and I have survived.

items.speaker: Team Member IV
items.text: It's okay. Don't worry about me. Any passing fishing boat will be able to see our distress signal. You just need to go back and wait.

items.speaker: Team Member IV
items.text: Here. It's a Neptune bar—my favorite. It'll keep you warm a little longer.
Nautika closes her diary.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: That's why you cannot go to the hinterlands.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: In fact, you-you should leave as soon as possible.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I see. So this is your concern.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But rest assured. We are taking every measure to ensure our safety. That said, even a draft map would be extremely helpful to us.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ah, I get it.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Please take this GPS device. I've pinged its location. Help will arrive soon.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: My apologies that we can't stay with you until they arrive. I'm afraid we're on a time limit. Excuse us.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Why?

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: W-Why don't you give up, even after all my warnings?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We have our reasons.
Wind and snow batter their coats as the two step outside.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: W-Wait!
Nautika, finding some hidden reserve of sanity and strength, shouts to her visitors.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: This land of ice is alive! It's alive, and it eats people! I'm not lying! You have no idea what horrors lie in the hinterland!

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Even if you somehow escape, you'll go insane! Just like—like Rolf, my grandfather!
The footsteps of those walking toward the snowfields slow.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: S-So, you have to stop! You have to! You have to ...

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: For your own safety.
Breaths hang in the silence.
After a pause, they turn back.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Rolf Amundsen?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I know that name.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: What?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The outstanding human explorer. His research has formed the basis for understanding many applications of arcanum. Countless arcanists have benefited from his work.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's said that your family holds a particular set of beliefs about the unsolved mysteries of the world, and that every one of you holds a passion for arcanum.
Nautika looks down.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Are-Are we that famous?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Indeed. It's widely known that many members of the Amundsen family became explorers. Their passion was so strong that it's been recorded in arcanist textbooks.
Nautika's eyes widen, cheeks red from coldness and excitement.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I assume you're here in pursuit of something, just like the rest of your family.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And that's why you're reluctant to leave, even after all the misfortune you've encountered. Is that right?

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Reluctant to leave? I pray to the Mother Spirit to take me away every single day.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This station is close to the shore. There are many ways you could've got the attention of passing ships if you'd wanted to.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We're also here in pursuit of something.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: A person, to be specific.
Nautika's eyes widen again, this time with confusion.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: A-A person?
A sigh echoes through the small station.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you familiar with Manus Vindictae?
In a dark cavern, ritual symbols have been carved in a massive array drawn in blood and papyrus ash.
The Roar Lion's Tail is placed at the top.
Tides run in blind by their ever-be routine,
Sacred Scarab Wings at the left.
Staining that Heaven with obscene calamity.
A seashell holding a spirit is embedded in a skull at the right.
The breaker of death's shackles shall rule us all,
Black soil from the rebels is placed above the idol.
The Fountain of Youth elixir from a cursed alchemist completes the offering.
From this day forth, and evermore.
The young Preacher stands at the altar's edge, watching distant shadows.
The figure she awaits traverses the narrow passageway, entering the altar cavern at last.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: You've arrived, as the prophecy foretold.
A blind woman approaches barefoot—in one hand a cup of Hauma, in the other a bundle of Barsom.
Finally, she stops at the ritual's sole vacant corner, completing its shape.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: The preparation of the ritual is about to enter its final stages.

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: The Inculcator of Arcanum, Lady Arcana, has revealed to me the final revelation and oracle. Hear ye:

items.speaker: Sophia the Preacher
items.text: The blind visitor shall start the great ritual on our behalf.
The black-clad believers kneel and prostrate themselves before the blind woman, their chanting synchronized and unceasing.
Her sightless eyes seem to pierce through eternity before finally settling on the ritual's center.
There stands a golden Spinning Wheel, locked in silent communion with her.
